name: Key Binds
author: Verdite3
description: Keyboard and mouse bindings for the game's pad buttons, read from a commented config next to this file (bindings.cfg): a held key or mouse button holds its button, the wheel fires one press per notch, and a button may take several inputs -- repeat its line. Injected through PAD_dr the way KF3_AUTOPAD does. Default: Cross (the action button) on the mouse wheel down.
